_comment: Fill in real org names and IDs before running the migration. orgId should be a short, stable, lowercase-hyphenated slug — it becomes the Firestore document ID under orgs/{orgId} and is never meant to change once set. defaultOrgId is where every existing user lands UNLESS their email appears in userAssignments below. Add one entry per org you want seeded; add one line per user whose email needs to go somewhere other than the default.

userAssignments._comment: email (lowercase, exact match to the users/{uid} doc's stored email field) -> orgId. Only list users who should NOT get defaultOrgId.
